regime_context: The detector shows AI Infrastructure as the top-ranked and eligible absolute-trend leader (1.56), with US Energy Complex (1.38) as the challenger on a narrowing rotation (eligible frac 0.45, margin 0.185). Gate helps on this market's history, so trend-discipline is the only validated leg; momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, and crowding is a size-down caution only. Track record n=95 is a usable sample but dir_accuracy 0.463 warns against high conviction on direction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether US Energy Complex closes the 0.185 score gap to AI Infrastructure AND its durability_bar holds above 0.5 — a confirmed leadership handoff would retire the 'AI dominates' read. Until then the rotation radar is display-only.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Highest-combination eligible theme with trend-gate durability on the absolute-trend leg and broad participation (breadth 0.636), making it the cleanest trend-following candidate in the current gate environment. Durability bar 0.62 exceeds the leader's 0.5, and breadth is the widest among top-5 eligible names — this is a staying-power read, not a momentum-alpha read.
theses.dissent: Energy is a cyclical beta to macro surprises and the unscheduled headline share is maxed at 1.0; a risk-off commodity drawdown would hit XLE without warning, and the mixed hurst tag means the trend is not cleanly persistent.

falsifier.text: XLE lags the S&P 500 by more than 5% from the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Trendiest eligible theme by hurst_tag (trend) with the highest durability_bar (0.75) in the top ranks and solid breadth (0.60), giving it the strongest absolute-trend persistence profile for a stay-with-it read. Its crowded flag (crowding_z 1.61) is a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.61 is the highest in the top tier — attention-driven inflows into CIBR can mark short-term tops, and the rank-IC ~0 momentum means leadership alone says nothing about forward return.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 4% from the check-by date

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Eligible but the only top-15 eligible theme with a mean-revert hurst tag (negative trend persistence), so the absolute-trend gate reads it as likely to chop rather than extend. Rank 14 is mid-pack and durability_bar 0.53 is unremarkable; underweight expresses absence of the validated staying-power edge.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag can flip to trend on a sector catalyst, and BOTZ has idiosyncratic AI-adjacent optionality that a pure trend-tag read overlooks; the underweight could miss a sharp automation theme re-rate.

falsifier.text: BOTZ beats the S&P 500 by more than 6% from the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
